name: btn-text-change
blurb: Text skews and flips to reveal duplicate text from below.
description: A button with overlaid text layers where the top text skews and flips up on hover while the bottom text flips up to replace it. Both layers rotate in a coordinated 3D-like motion.
use_when: A premium CTA with dynamic interactive motion.
avoid_when: When text must remain stable or the design is minimalist.
a11y: Native button element. Duplicate text may confuse screen readers.
